output.explanation: Expanded io-terminal because Screen-owned PageLists hide substantial composition. Its central tree retains Terminal -> ScreenSet -> Screen -> PageList ownership, with peripherals detailing PageList nodes, pools and tracked pins, and page-local row/cell storage. Left core, io, render and io-exec unchanged. Checked the pinned checkout's ownership declarations, teardown paths, parsing/resize synchronization and renderer snapshot boundary. Clarified that compressed nodes retain complete Page metadata and the virtual mapping, cells are column-ordered within row-selected spans rather than globally row-ordered, and backing-memory release follows the node's pool/heap ownership tag. Preserved all existing edges, updating moved terminal endpoints.

diagrams.ascii:
Ghostty: Surface-centered session system
|
|-- Core App (src/App.zig)
|   |-- surfaces: registered *apprt.Surface; focused_surface: checked reference
|   |-- mailbox: worker-to-main-thread messages
|   |   `-- tick -> drainMailbox -> hasSurface -> Surface.handleMessage
|   |-- font_grid_set: shared, reference-counted font grids
|   |-- device: optional app-owned GPU device, borrowed by renderers
|   `-- deinit: runtime surface cleanup before shared fonts and device
|
`-- Runtime-managed surface hosts (apprt.Surface; src/apprt.zig)
    |-- Runtime chooses window/tab/split/pane; delivers events
    `-- Core Surface (src/Surface.zig): owns one terminal session
        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface: borrowed references, not owned hosts
        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig
        |   `-- updateConfig -> derived settings to I/O and renderer mailboxes
        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited
        |-- keyCallback / textCallback / mouseButtonCallback
        |   |-- Binding action -> local operation or rt_app.performAction
        |   |-- Encode key/mouse/paste using io.terminal protocol state
        |   `-- queueIo -> io.queueMessage; takes ownership; readonly drops writes
        |-- sizeCallback -> resize: pixels + cell metrics + padding
        |   `-- -> queueIo(.resize) AND renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup
        |-- io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
        |   |-- backend: Backend.exec -> Exec -> subprocess + PTY
        |   |-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (the sole emulation state)
        |   `-- mailbox / derived config / current size
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread manager; io_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- drainMailbox -> io.queueWrite; coalesces resize requests
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)
        |   |-- terminal -> &io.terminal; NOT another owned terminal
        |   |-- mutex + preedit + renderer-facing mouse state
        |   `-- lockDemand / unlockDemand / yieldToDemand: fairness handoff
        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)
        |   `-- Own frame state; borrow App device and shared font grid
        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread manager; renderer_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- Wakeups/timers -> renderer.updateFrame / drawFrame
        |-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), also from main thread
        |-- Optional search worker and inspector
        |-- childExited(): record exit; native UI or terminal text
        |   |-- Abnormally short run -> report and return, keep surface open
        |   `-- Normal exit: wait_after_command holds; otherwise close()
        |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit())
        |   `-- Runtime close lifecycle -> Surface.deinit()
        `-- deinit(): ordered release
            |-- Stop/join search, then renderer thread, then I/O thread
            |-- I/O thread exit -> Exec stops child and joins PTY reader
            |-- Free renderer before renderer_thread, then I/O resources
            `-- Release input/preedit/mutex/config; deref App font grid

Termio: session I/O and emulation (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend: Backend (src/termio/backend.zig)
|   `-- exec: Exec -> owns Subprocess and its PTY [expanded]
|-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   |-- parser + UTF8Decoder: incremental byte interpretation
|   `-- handler: StreamHandler (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|       |-- Owned APC / DCS / clipboard transaction and grant state
|       |-- terminal reference -> &this Termio.terminal
|       |-- Protocol replies -> mailbox -> PTY write path
|       |-- surface_mailbox -> App.mailbox -> checked main-thread dispatch
|       `-- queueRender() -> renderer wakeup (no direct native UI calls)
|-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|   |-- Geometry + protocol/session state (modes / colors / title / pwd)
|   `-- screens: ScreenSet -> owned Screens -> PageLists [expanded]
|-- mailbox: input writes / protocol replies / control messages
|   `-- Surface.io_thread drains -> queueWrite -> Backend.queueWrite
|-- config: owned DerivedConfig; size: current renderer.Size
|-- renderer_state: borrowed Surface.renderer_state (not another Terminal)
|-- renderer_mailbox / renderer_wakeup / surface_mailbox: cross-thread routes
|-- thread_enter_state: temporary owned startup config
|-- processOutput(bytes), invoked by Exec reader
|   |-- Lock Surface.renderer_state.mutex
|   |-- Schedule queueRender while locked, then terminal_stream.nextSlice
|   `-- Unlock; reader yieldToDemand lets pending renderer snapshot proceed
|-- resize(size), invoked after io_thread coalescing
|   |-- size.grid(): reconcile pixels, cell metrics and padding
|   |-- Under same terminal mutex: Backend.resize then Terminal.resize
|   |   `-- Child redraw cannot be parsed with obsolete terminal dimensions
|   `-- -> renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup
`-- threadEnter / threadExit -> Backend lifecycle
    `-- Exec runtime handles live in Termio.ThreadData.backend.exec

Renderer: per-Surface frame preparation and presentation
|
|-- GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) (src/renderer/generic.zig)
|   |-- terminal_state: owned terminal.RenderState snapshot
|   |-- font_shaper / prepared cells / image and GPU resources
|   |-- font_grid: borrowed App shared grid (glyph atlas/cache)
|   |-- Graphics API uses borrowed App.device
|   |   `-- Compile-time Metal or OpenGL (src/renderer.zig)
|   |-- updateFrame(Surface.renderer_state)
|   |   |-- lockDemand() -> shared Terminal + viewport + dirty state
|   |   |-- May scroll viewport / advance Kitty animations while locked
|   |   |-- terminal_state.beginUpdate + copy preedit/mouse/image data
|   |   |-- unlockDemand() -> terminal_state.endUpdate() outside lock
|   |   `-- Snapshot + shaping + atlas -> cells, selection, cursor, images
|   `-- drawFrame() -> Graphics API -> runtime host surface
|
`-- Scheduling: sibling Surface.renderer_thread (src/renderer/Thread.zig)
    |-- Mailbox / wakeups / timers drive updateFrame and drawFrame
    |   `-- Incoming .resize updates display geometry
    |-- I/O queueRender -> wakeup; frame reads shared state under mutex
    |-- Surface.draw() -> drawFrame(true) can run on main thread
    `-- Teardown: join renderer thread, then free renderer before its manager

Termio backend.exec: Exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|
|-- subprocess: Subprocess (owned)
|   |-- arena / cwd / env / args: launch configuration
|   |-- grid_size / screen_size
|   |-- pty: ?Pty; process: ?Process
|   |   `-- Process = Command (fork_exec) or Flatpak host command
|   |-- start() -> Pty.open + configured command launch
|   |-- resize() -> PTY geometry update
|   `-- stop() -> terminate/reap as needed; clear process
|-- threadEnter() -> start subprocess; initialize td.backend.exec
|   `-- Runtime state is held by I/O-thread Termio.ThreadData, not Exec
|       |-- write_stream + write_queue + pooled 64-byte write requests
|       |-- process watcher / start time / exited flag
|       |   `-- processExitCommon -> Surface mailbox .child_exited
|       |-- termios timer (POSIX) -> terminal password-input state
|       `-- read_thread handle + quit pipe + PTY read fd
|           |-- POSIX io-reader owns Pipeline and spawns/joins io-gather
|           |   |-- Pipeline: four 64-KiB rotating buffers
|           |   |-- Ring metadata mutex + batch_ready / slot_free conditions
|           |   |-- io-gather: PTY reads -> publish batches; bounded backpressure
|           |   `-- io-reader: batches -> Termio.processOutput -> terminal stream
|           |-- Windows: blocking read -> processOutput in one serial loop
|           `-- After parsing: renderer_state.yieldToDemand (terminal unlocked)
|-- queueWrite(data, linefeed)
|   |-- -> td write pool/queue -> PTY -> child; skip if exited
|   `-- Optional CR-to-CRLF conversion; completions recycle requests
`-- threadExit(td)
    |-- Record external exit if observed; stop subprocess first
    |-- Signal quit pipe; Windows also cancels blocking read
    `-- Join io-reader (which joins POSIX io-gather); td.deinit frees handles

Termio.terminal: Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|
|-- Geometry: rows / cols / pixel dimensions / scrolling_region / tabstops
|-- Protocol/session state: modes / colors / title / pwd / mouse flags
|-- Terminal-level cursor state (screen coordinates live in Screen.cursor)
|-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|   |-- all: owned Screen pointers; primary eager, alternate lazy
|   |   `-- Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
|   |       |-- cursor: coordinates / style / pending_wrap / hyperlink state
|   |       |   `-- page_pin / page_row / page_cell -> current page storage
|   |       |-- saved_cursor / selection (selection uses tracked pins)
|   |       |-- charset / protected_mode / kitty_keyboard
|   |       |-- kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
|   |       `-- pages: PageList [expanded: io-pages]
|   |           |-- pages: ordered nodes, history through active screen
|   |           |   `-- Node: links / serial / pool-or-heap ownership tag
|   |           |       `-- data: resident Page or compressed Page [io-page]
|   |           `-- Pools / tracked pins / viewport / limits / compression state
|   |-- active + active_key: alias into all, not a separately owned Screen
|   `-- generations: distinguish replaced screen storage
|-- resize() -> Screen/PageList geometry and reflow
|-- StreamHandler operations -> mutate this Terminal and its active Screen
|-- Renderer -> samples viewport/cells/dirty state under Surface mutex
`-- deinit() -> ScreenSet destroys Screens -> Screen releases PageList storage

Screen.pages: PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
|
|-- pages: intrusive doubly linked List
|   `-- Node: prev / next / serial
|       |-- owned: pool or heap; determines backing-memory release
|       `-- data: tagged storage representation
|           |-- resident: page.Page [expanded: io-page]
|           `-- compressed: compress.Page
|               |-- page: complete Page metadata + retained virtual mapping
|               `-- encoded: owned LZ4 bytes; alloc frees encoded storage
|-- pool: MemoryPool
|   |-- nodes: NodePool (reuses node allocations)
|   |-- pages: PagePool (standard-sized backing blocks)
|   `-- pins: PinPool (allocates tracked Pin objects)
|-- tracked_pins: set of *Pin, maintained across page mutations
|   `-- trackPin / untrackPin -> allocate / recycle through pool.pins
|-- viewport: active / top / pin
|   `-- viewport_pin: preallocated tracked pin; cached row offset
|-- page_serial / page_serial_epoch: reference validity generations
|-- limits / total_rows / page_size / desired rows and cols
|-- page_compression: incremental continuation state
|-- grow_hints / recycle_node: allocation and reflow reuse state
|-- resize / grow / pruning -> change pages and maintain tracked pins
|   `-- Screen cursor and selection reference these maintained pins
|-- compress() -> select cold, fully historical resident pages
|   `-- Encode first; decommit mapping; publish compressed state on success
|-- Node.page() -> restore compressed contents into retained mapping
|   `-- Recommit / decode / free encoding; return resident Page
|-- Node.pagePreservingState() -> borrow resident or allocate decoded copy
|   `-- Caller releases copy; exclusive PageList access still required
`-- deinit() -> release tracked-pin set, nodes and backing storage, then pools

Node's terminal Page (src/terminal/page.zig)
|
|-- memory: one contiguous page-aligned backing block
|   |-- Row storage: ordered top to bottom
|   |   `-- Row: packed metadata
|   |       |-- cells: offset selecting this row's column-ordered span
|   |       `-- wrap / continuation / dirty / content-presence flags
|   |-- Cell storage: spans are NOT globally ordered by row
|   |   `-- Cell: packed content and attributes
|   |       |-- content_tag + content: codepoint or background color
|   |       |-- style_id -> page-local styles; zero means default
|   |       `-- wide / protected / hyperlink / semantic_content
|   `-- Auxiliary storage addressed through page-local offsets
|       |-- styles: reference-counted style set
|       |-- grapheme_map: cell offset -> extra-codepoint allocation
|       |-- grapheme_alloc: bitmap-managed grapheme storage
|       |-- hyperlink_map: cell offset -> hyperlink ID
|       |-- hyperlink_set: IDs -> reference-counted hyperlink records
|       `-- string_alloc: shared UTF-8 storage used by hyperlink records
|-- Page metadata: rows/cells offsets, allocator and set descriptors
|-- size / capacity: populated dimensions versus fixed allocation capacity
|-- dirty: whole-page invalidation; false does not imply all rows clean
|-- init() -> allocate backing; initBuf() -> use caller-supplied backing
|   `-- PageList node ownership tag governs release of its backing
|-- Compressed representation retains this entire Page value
|   `-- Raw mapping must be restored before reading its contents
`-- Row/cell data -> renderer snapshot under Surface's terminal mutex
